metadata.title: Pegylated Liposomal Doxorubicin 50 mg/m² – 28 day
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00205 Version 8. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Recurrent or advanced endometrial cancer and advanced ovarian cancer after prior platinum therapy.

hypersensitivity.label: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component

febrile_neutropenia.label: Febrile neutropenia or neutropenic sepsis during the previous interval

mucositis_grade.label: Mucositis/stomatitis grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No adverse event.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild or asymptomatic; observation only and intervention generally not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; minimal, local or non-invasive intervention may be indicated; may limit instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant but not immediately life-threatening; hospital care may be indicated; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess pain, ulceration and the effect on oral intake; distinguish altered diet from inability to eat or drink.

eligibility: Indication as listed in the current official NCCP regimen

exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component

Regimen-specific exclusions encoded in the interactive assessment
monitoring: FBC, renal and liver profile as specified by the current NCCP regimen
